blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The defense counsel of Vice President Sara Duterte will call to the stand on Wednesday the corporate counsel of GenCorp Industries, Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp. Although initially scheduled to testify at an earlier date, Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay will be the fourth defense witness after her testimony was postponed because of an MRI appointment she had last Monday. READ: Resigning never crossed Sara Duterte’s mind despite impeachment, says spox Balucanag-Punay is expected to present the General Information Sheets (GIS) and Audited Financial Statements of the two corporations linked to Duterte from 2022 to 2025.
